source: The first 51 foods come from the user-maintained personal food reference sheet (Food Log.pdf); values marked approximate or brand-dependent there are reasonable defaults, not verified label data. Generic ingredients come from USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy 2018 and FNDDS 2024, public domain), per 100 g as sold (raw unless the name says cooked). Branded Egyptian products come from Open Food Facts label data (ODbL), kept only where calories agree with protein, carbs and fat within 15%. Hero, Lino High Protein and Amr peanut butter were corrected from their label photos, where Open Food Facts had per-serving values in the per-100 g column. category keys are defined in shared/lib/food-categories.ts. previousNames lets a preset be renamed without orphaning meals logged against it.
